detail: The replacement id does not exist until create returns, so a pre-create back-link is impossible without pre-generating ids (invasive store change) or double-writing (two locks, two export-tree writes). Post-create also fixes a latent inconsistency: previously, if create threw, the old decision was left superseded with no successor. The conflict-filter exclusion (entry.id !== input.supersedes) preserves the prior behavior where the already-flipped target never appeared as a conflict.
summary: Moved the supersede status flip in DecisionEngine.decide from before create to after create, writing status and superseded_by in one updateStatus call; conflict scan now excludes the supersede target
